note: What beatsync's gates (tests/beatsync-*.mjs) need to know about the game.

autopilot.note: The frames of the autopilot cart (games/beatsync/src/main.c GAME_AUTOPILOT: the first song on Hard, every note hit) tests/beatsync-programs.mjs plays: through the first drop and the break.

newcomer.note: tests/beatsync-newcomer.mjs: the first song on Easy, played from the next note's cue (cue.lane, cue.ms against song.ms); cleared when song.done is 1 (the crowd stayed to the end).

forgiving.note: tests/beatsync-forgiving.mjs: the first song on Easy and Medium played by a person on a living-room setup (late on average, a wide spread, a slipped thumb now and then); cleared with at least minAccuracy for that difficulty (Perfect 1, Good a half; 0.70 is a C on Easy, 0.55 a D on Medium). Controls: the old judgement (rules old) and a masher must fail.

flash.note: The hit glow at the gates, a multiplier step's band rising up the rivers, a broken streak's drain (the autopilot lets one note go at frame 1300, after a streak of about 50), and the failed song's dip to dark, over the whole first song on Hard; the crowd is sent home (the `leave` request) after it, for the dip.

picture.note: frame({op:'flash'}): every frame of the densest song played whole by the autopilot on Hard, from the count-in to the results (tests/beatsync-flash.mjs works out the frames from the song)
